decision.summaryForCoordinator: The token-enumeration prohibition is the one that cannot be checked by inspection, so I recovered the forbidden vocabulary from d9-exit-contract.v1.14 before opening the subject: six class tokens — success, policy-failed, request-rejected, indeterminate, operational-failed, interrupted — and six codes, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 130. ZERO of the class tokens appears in the subject in any case. Of the codes, 0, 2, 3, 4 and 130 are absent entirely, and the only integers present anywhere are 1 and 26 — the version field and required-now — with every occurrence of the word 'exit' carrying no number. That matters because the artifact legitimately contains 'D9' fifteen times and 'HostTermination' ten: the live DR-G28 register claim itself reads 'must not mint a D9 class, exit, or HostTermination', so a token-count sweep would flag this file heavily and wrongly. All four named states are exact substrings of live G28 v3 exactByteIntent strings — two from the NT-7 and NT-8 corpus classes and two from retainedEvidence — and the source labels on the latter two, 'policyOutcome is not HostTermination' and 'invents no D9 code', are live NT-8 suppliesMembers that also appear verbatim in the live register evidence cell. One detail is worth naming as evidence of deliberate restraint rather than an accidental gap: NT-8 carries three supplied members and the subject names states for only two. The one it leaves unnamed is 'host maps only existing D9 v1.14 classes' — precisely the member whose concrete elaboration would invite listing the class set — and instead of elaborating it the subject attaches the standing note 'This catalog does not enumerate D9 v1.14 tokens' to the NT-8 state. It also declines to carry the d9-exit-contract.v1.14 pin that the live harness does carry, keeping the vocabulary further away still. D-154 was read at source and confirms 'It owns DR-131 NT-7 and NT-8 only', 'NT-7 and NT-8 leftover-design closes: remainder is G28 execution' and 'Not SATISFIED'; the subject reproduces the closure and refuses to reopen it three times. The NT census is exactly NT-7 and NT-8 with no other number, matching the grant. It cites harness v3 where v1 and v2 also exist on disk, the gate join re-measures with OBL-G28-FX-AUTHORING true as its sole leftover, all five cited digests match, all four fixtureBytes read NOT-AUTHORED with no digest or path in initialStates, and the subject did not move. Twenty-five attacks run, twenty-five refuted, zero findings. Note also that DR-131's live row carries SATISFIED text in its blocker cell — a hazard that needed explicit answering on the G25 and G28 leftover-joins — but the input-corpus shape carries no file08StatusToken at all, removing the route.
